title: Principles for Marriage, Live as You Are Called

questions.question: Now concerning the matters about which you wrote: "It is good for a man not to ____."
options: have sexual relations with a woman
questions.correctAnswer: have sexual relations with a woman
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 7:1 (ESV): "Now concerning the matters about which you wrote: 'It is good for a man not to have sexual relations with a woman.'"

questions.question: But because of the temptation to sexual immorality, each man should have his own wife and each woman her own ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 7:2 (ESV): "But because of the temptation to sexual immorality, each man should have his own wife and each woman her own husband."

questions.question: The husband should give to his wife her conjugal rights, and likewise the wife to her husband. For the wife does not have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the ____ does.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 7:3-4 (ESV): "The husband should give to his wife her conjugal rights, and likewise the wife to her husband... Likewise the husband does not have authority over his own body, but the wife does."

questions.question: Do not deprive one another, except perhaps by agreement for a limited time, that you may devote yourselves to ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 7:5 (ESV): "Do not deprive one another, except perhaps by agreement for a limited time, that you may devote yourselves to prayer; but then come together again, so that Satan may not tempt you because of your lack of self-control."

questions.question: To the unmarried and the widows I say that it is good for them to remain single, as I am. But if they cannot exercise self-control, they should ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 7:8-9 (ESV): "To the unmarried and the widows I say that it is good for them to remain single, as I am. But if they cannot exercise self-control, they should marry."

questions.question: Why does Paul say it is better to marry if they cannot exercise self-control?
options: For it is better to marry than to burn with passion
For God ordained marriage for all
Lest they fall away from the faith entirely
To avoid the reproach of the community
questions.correctAnswer: For it is better to marry than to burn with passion
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 7:9 (ESV): "But if they cannot exercise self-control, they should marry. For it is better to marry than to burn with passion."

questions.question: To the married I give this charge (not I, but the Lord): the wife should not separate from her husband... and the husband should not ____ his wife.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 7:10-11 (ESV): "To the married I give this charge (not I, but the Lord): the wife should not separate from her husband... and the husband should not divorce his wife."

questions.question: To the rest I say (I, not the Lord) that if any brother has a wife who is an unbeliever, and she consents to live with him, he should not divorce her... For the unbelieving husband is made holy because of his wife, and the unbelieving wife is made holy because of her husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but as it is, they are ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 7:12-14 (ESV): "For the unbelieving husband is made holy because of his wife, and the unbelieving wife is made holy because of her husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but as it is, they are holy."

questions.question: But if the unbelieving partner separates, let it be so. In such cases the brother or sister is not ____. God has called you to peace.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 7:15 (ESV): "But if the unbelieving partner separates, let it be so. In such cases the brother or sister is not enslaved. God has called you to peace."

questions.question: Only let each person lead the life that the Lord has ____ to him, and to which God has called him.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 7:17 (ESV): "Only let each person lead the life that the Lord has assigned to him, and to which God has called him. This is my rule in all the churches."

questions.question: For neither circumcision counts for anything nor uncircumcision, but keeping the ____ of God.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 7:19 (ESV): "For neither circumcision counts for anything nor uncircumcision, but keeping the commandments of God."

questions.question: Were you a bondservant when called? Do not be concerned about it. (But if you can gain your freedom, avail yourself of the opportunity.) For he who was called in the Lord as a bondservant is a ____ of the Lord.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 7:22 (ESV): "For he who was called in the Lord as a bondservant is a freedman of the Lord. Likewise he who was free when called is a bondservant of Christ."

questions.question: Paul says, "Are you bound to a wife? Do not seek to be free. Are you free from a wife? Do not seek a wife." Why does he give this advice in verse 26?
options: In view of the present distress
Because the end of the world is tomorrow
To increase their time for prayer
To save them from financial ruin
questions.correctAnswer: In view of the present distress
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 7:26 (ESV): "I think that in view of the present distress it is good for a person to remain as he is."

questions.question: Paul wants them to be free from anxieties. The unmarried man is anxious about the things of the Lord, how to please the Lord. But the married man is anxious about worldly things, how to ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 7:32-33 (ESV): "The unmarried man is anxious about the things of the Lord, how to please the Lord. But the married man is anxious about worldly things, how to please his wife,"

questions.question: A wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to be married to whom she wishes, only ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 7:39 (ESV): "A wife is bound to her husband as long as he lives. But if her husband dies, she is free to be married to whom she wishes, only in the Lord."

key_verse_text: Only let each person lead the life that the Lord has assigned to him, and to which God has called him. This is my rule in all the churches.
